name: Zhertvy poterjannyh solnechnyh dnej: Zatmenie
source: You accidentally find a game you don't remember having and launch it. There seems to be nothing strange about it: it’s a regular children's game with bright graphics. But in this colorful and friendly world, an ominous eclipse sets in…
translation: 你不小心发现了一个你不记得的游戏并启动了它。这似乎没有什么奇怪的：这是一个普通的儿童游戏，有着明亮的图形。但在这个多彩而友好的世界里，一场不祥的日食开始了……
